sources.title: LanguageMachines/blip2-opt-2.7b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BLIP-2, OPT-2.7b, pre-trained only BLIP-2 model, leveraging OPT-2.7b (a large language model with 2.7 billion parameters). It was introduced in the paper BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models by Li et al. and first released in this repository.
